Security policy

Source: SECURITY.md

Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest version on main (currently 0.7.x). Older versions are not patched; please update.

Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems.

  1. Use GitHub’s private reporting: https://github.com/alexseymer/onedevR/security/advisories/new
  2. Or email the maintainer (address in DESCRIPTION) with “onedevr security” in the subject.

Include the affected version, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days and a fix or a mitigation plan as soon as the report is confirmed. Reporters are credited in NEWS.md unless they prefer to stay anonymous.

What counts as a vulnerability

Examples: credentials (token, password) that end up in output, logs, cache keys or requests to a host other than the configured one; query or request construction that lets input change what is sent to OneDev; unsafe file writes in the download and log helpers; vulnerable dependencies.

Safe usage

  • Keep tokens in .Renviron or CI secrets, never in code. .Renviron and .env are git-ignored; do not commit them.
  • Use a token with the minimum permissions the script needs.
  • Do not set ONEDEV_CURL_INSECURE=1 (or insecure_ssl = TRUE) except on networks you trust. The package warns once per session when it is on.
  • Treat od_connection objects as secrets; print() and str() mask them, but unclass() and saveRDS() do not.

How the project is monitored

Check Where When
Known vulnerabilities in R dependencies (installed and minimum versions, via OSV) scripts/audit-deps.R, workflow security weekly, pull requests, on demand
Secrets committed to the repository gitleaks in workflow security every push and pull request, weekly
Insecure patterns in GitHub Actions workflows CodeQL (actions) in workflow security pushes to main, pull requests, weekly
Outdated GitHub Actions Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) weekly

Run the dependency audit locally with Rscript scripts/audit-deps.R.
